'''Glastro''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]].<ref name="Heir" /> The city was noted for its production of [[Glastroan wine]],<ref name="GUSWI" /> and was home to the [[Tower of Law]].<ref name="Heir" />
